title: headless-home-server config
description: Identifiers and choices only. Secrets (tunnel credentials, API keys, passwords) never go in this file.

adminUser.description: The macOS admin account you log in with. Deploys run as this user.

serviceUser.description: Hidden non-admin account that runs every service and the tunnel.

lanIp.description: The server's LAN address, for the SSH alias. Reserve it on your router.

repoPath.description: Where your clone lives on the server, e.g. ~/git/my-home-server.

exposure.description: Needed only when a service uses auth public or access.

accessTeam.description: Cloudflare Zero Trust team name, for services with auth access.

dir.description: Folder in this repo that holds the service. It is copied to the service user's home on deploy.

run.description: Command started inside that folder, as the service user. It gets PORT and HOST=127.0.0.1.

auth.description: public: anyone on the internet via the tunnel (the service does its own auth). access: via the tunnel, behind a Cloudflare Access policy. tailscale: only your tailnet. local: only this machine (reach it over SSH).

hostname.description: Public hostname, for public and access.

accessAud.description: Application Audience tag of the Access app, for access.
